    a tolerant CSR write, a PB store to an absent L2C region faults. Every
    current engine is built without an L2C, so this is transported
    forward-looking and no-ops today.

@@ -101,6 +101,36 @@ inline constexpr uint32_t encode_addi(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
          | 0x13u;  // OP-IMM opcode (funct3=000)
 }
 
+// Encode `lwu rd, imm12(rs1)` (LOAD opcode 0x03, funct3=110 for 32-bit ZERO-
+// extend, I-type). L2C MMIO registers must be accessed less than 8 bytes at a
+// time (DS220 11.8.3), so the L2C config read-back loads a word. lwu (not lw)
+// so a 32-bit register value does not sign-extend into the upper bits of the
+// 64-bit GPR it lands in.
+inline constexpr uint32_t encode_lwu(uint8_t rd, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
+{
+    return ((uint32_t(imm12) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
+         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
+         | (0b110u << 12)
+         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
+         | 0x03u;  // LOAD opcode
+}
+
+// Encode `sw rs2, imm12(rs1)` (STORE opcode 0x23, funct3=010 for 32-bit,
+// S-type: imm[11:5] -> bits 31:25, imm[4:0] -> bits 11:7). L2C MMIO registers
+// must be accessed less than 8 bytes at a time (DS220 11.8.3), so the L2C
+// config restore writes a word. All documented L2C control bits live in the
+// low 32 bits.
+inline constexpr uint32_t encode_sw(uint8_t rs2, uint8_t rs1, int32_t imm12)
+{
+    const uint32_t imm = uint32_t(imm12) & 0xFFFu;
+    return ((imm >> 5) & 0x7Fu) << 25
+         | ((uint32_t(rs2) & 0x1Fu) << 20)
+         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
+         | (0b010u << 12)
+         | ((imm & 0x1Fu) << 7)
+         | 0x23u;  // STORE opcode
+}
+

feat(hybrid): L2C MMIO config restore/drain via the Program Buffer (ABI v5)

This lands the consumer side of the v5 L2C block, so the L2 cache
controller's boot-static configuration round-trips across the QEMU1 ->
vsim handoff. ResumeDriver::restore_l2c writes back ONLY the writable
config registers -- Control (0x0008: CEN enable, prefetch, ECC, RAM
timing), HPM Control (0x0010), and the Way Allocation Masks (0x0300..)
-- as Program-Buffer `sw` word stores, per DS220 11.8.3's rule that L2C
MMIO registers must be accessed less than 8 bytes at a time; the address
and low word stage into x5/x6 before the GPR loop overwrites them. The
read-only Configuration Register, the side-effecting CCTL command
registers (writing one re-issues an L2 cache op), and the write-1-clear
error registers are captured in the record but never written back.
StateDrain::drain_l2c is the dual: `lwu` zero-extending read-backs of
the same registers so --verify compares the round-tripped values instead
of the stale QEMU1 passthrough. Both sides are HARD-gated on the engine
actually having an L2C (Simulator::l2c_present(), from
_NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB > 0 rather than the cluster's has_shared_cache,
which also covers L3 on ax46/ax66): unlike a tolerant CSR write, a
Program-Buffer store to an absent L2C region faults, so a core without
one must issue nothing, and every current engine is built
NDS_L2C_CACHE_SIZE_KB=0, making this transport forward-looking and a
no-op today. New encode_sw / encode_lwu encoders join the Program-Buffer
toolkit, and the external andesim_abi submodule is pinned at ABI v5
(struct hybrid_l2c, HYBRID_FLAG_L2C).
